axis.description: transcription: fidelity of text to the source image. identification: certainty the record is what it is labeled as (right document, right parties, right date). provenance: strength of the custody chain from original to GAH.

does_not_mean.const: This label describes evidence quality only. It is not a statement about whether any allegation in or around this record is true.
does_not_mean.description: Mandatory boilerplate. Must render adjacent to every public confidence label.

rationale.description: One sentence: why this level on this axis.

description: Document-level audit trail for a single GAH archive record. Governs Phase 0 of the approved V2 rebuild (GAH_REBUILD_APPROVED_V2.md). A provenance record describes the record's identity, origin, integrity, acquisition, relationships, what it establishes, what it does not establish, and its correction history. It NEVER asserts the truth of an allegation; allegation adjudication is out of scope by design.

acquisition.description: How GAH obtained the record. Internal custody chain, one entry per hop.

action.description: E.g. 'downloaded from DOJ dataset 11', 'OCR via tesseract 5.3.4', 'parent recovered from Gmail-export PDF'.

actor.description: 'operator', 'pipeline', or named agent. No anonymous steps.

change_log.description: Append-only record of modifications to this provenance entry.

suggested_citation.description: One-line citable reference, e.g. 'Grok Archive Hub, EFTA01975333 (DOJ dataset 11), accessed 2026-10-09.'

collection.description: Source collection. Barak-archive rows and EFTA rows are different collections and MUST NOT be merged into one record.

corrections.description: Document-level correction history. Every public correction touching this record's GAH rendering lands here.

affected_route.description: Public GAH route whose rendering changed.

change.description: Narrow description of what changed and why.

source_trigger.description: What prompted the correction: tip, re-verification, new record.

established.description: DOCUMENTED FACTS ONLY. Each entry states what the record directly shows, with a verbatim quote or precise locator. No inference. No allegation adjudication.

locator.description: Verbatim quote and/or page/line/footer reference, e.g. 'p.3, lines 12-14' or 'footer EFTA00035161'.

negative_control.description: True when the entry is a bounded negative finding: what the record does NOT show, within stated bounds.

statement.description: Narrow factual statement directly supported by the record.

gah_record_id.description: Stable GAH-internal identifier, e.g. 'EFTA01975333' or 'BARAK-174-008'. Must be unique across collections when prefixed by collection.

identifiers.description: Original identifiers as issued by the source, preserved verbatim.

native_message_id.description: Original email Message-ID header where recovered.

integrity.description: Byte-level integrity evidence. Absence of a hash is recorded as a gap, never silently omitted.

hash_gap_reason.description: Required when sha256 is null. E.g. 'original binary excluded from snapshot; hash held in operator archive', 'source URL dead at acquisition'.

hash_scope.description: What the sha256 was computed over.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original file bytes. Null only with hash_gap_reason set.

interpretations.description: Editorial interpretations, clearly typed as such. Each interpretation names its basis and its limits. Interpretations are never rendered as facts.

author.description: Who advanced it: 'gah_editorial', named investigator, or 'external:<source>'.

basis.description: Which established facts this interpretation rests on.

limits.description: What would falsify or weaken it; what is still missing.

not_established.description: What the record does NOT prove. Mandatory for any record cited in an investigation. Silence is preserved, not filled.

statement.description: E.g. 'Does not establish that the proposed contact occurred.'

original_source.description: Where the record came from outside GAH.

doj_dataset.description: DOJ Epstein release dataset number, 1-12, where applicable.

issuing_authority.description: Who issued the original: e.g. 'U.S. Department of Justice', 'House Oversight Committee', 'SDNY'.

source_url.description: Canonical public URL of the original (e.g. justice.gov DOJ dataset URL, court ECF link).

source_url_status.description: Last-observed HTTP status class of source_url.

provenance_quality.description: Confidence label for THIS RECORD's provenance/identification/transcription quality. See GAH_CONFIDENCE_STANDARDS.md. It describes evidence quality ONLY — never certainty that any allegation is true.

relationships.description: Parent/child/thread links. Enables the /barak/emails/{id} viewer thread position and dossier 'connected records'.

parent_document.description: gah_record_id of the parent (e.g. email thread root, PDF the render came from).

same_content_elsewhere.description: Other gah_record_ids carrying the same underlying content (e.g. Barak leak row + DOJ EFTA row of the same email). Listed as related, never merged.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this schema document itself.

unresolved.description: Open receipt slots: missing, ambiguous, degraded, or pending items. An unresolved question is not proof of anything.

title: GAH Document-Level Provenance Record
